name: datamove
description: DataMove - open-source data integration platform (Fivetran/Airbyte-style) built on Node.js

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run migrate -w backend && npm run seed -w backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,sched,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev -w backend --workspace api 2>/dev/null || npm -w backend run api" "npm -w backend run scheduler" "npm -w backend run worker" "npm -w frontend run dev"
scripts.start: npm -w backend run api & npm -w backend run scheduler & npm -w backend run worker
